lookback_source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

lookback_notes: O0110 (including B1, Radiation) has three columns, each with its own assessment period. The assessor observation window recorded here (14 days) is the one for Column b, While a Resident: "Performed while a resident of this facility and within the last 14 days" (p. O-1), reinforced by the Item Rationale reference to "the 14-day look-back period" (p. O-2). Other stated windows for this item: Column a, On Admission = "days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B" (p. O-1, p. O-3); Column c, At Discharge = "the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending on A2400C" (p. O-1, p. O-3). The item's own pages state these windows, so the general 7-day convention does not apply.

coding_levels.label: Radiation — On Admission
coding_levels.definition: Check if radiation was received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

coding_levels.label: Radiation — While a Resident

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

coding_levels.label: Radiation — At Discharge
coding_levels.definition: Check if radiation was received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

coding_levels.label: None of the above
coding_levels.definition: If no treatments, procedures, or programs (including radiation) were received or performed in the applicable assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column a (On Admission): check radiation if received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B; if none were received or performed in the 3-day assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column b (While a Resident): check radiation if received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days; if none within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry, check Z, None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column c (At Discharge): check radiation if received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C; if none in that 3-day assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Where radiation is received during the first three days of the SNF PPS stay and while a resident, check both O0110B1a (On Admission) and O0110B1b (While a Resident).

case_mix_relevance.notes: The O0110 pages define assessment periods in terms of the SNF PPS Stay (A2400B/A2400C) but do not state that O0110B, Radiation, feeds a payment or case-mix classification.

conflicts.topic: Coexisting observation windows for O0110B (14-day 'While a Resident' window vs. 3-day admission and discharge windows)

positions.claim: Column b, While a Resident, uses a 14-day window: performed while a resident of this facility and within the last 14 days.

source.quote: Performed while a resident of this facility and within the last 14 days

positions.claim: Column a, On Admission, uses a 3-day window (days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B), and Column c, At Discharge, uses the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending on A2400C.

source.quote: Assessment period is days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B

positions.claim: Item Rationale describes the item as reviewed over a 14-day look-back period.

source.quote: programs that the resident was involved in during the 14-day look-back period is important to ensure the continued appropriateness of the treatments, procedures, or programs

conflicts.resolution: Not a contradiction: the document itself assigns a different assessment period to each column (p. O-3). Recorded so both windows are preserved; 14 days is used as the item's primary observation window (Column b).
